primary.robustness: ΔR = Δ mean|ΔNormalScore_z|（相对同 (category,seed) corrected Original；越低越好）
primary.preservation: Δd′ = Δ mean defect d′（越高越好）
primary.PASS: ΔR <= -EPS_RZ(0.02) 且 Δd′ >= -EPS_DP(0.10)（5A-H/7A-O/Exp10/11 冻结带）
primary.HOLD: 同 PASS 带内但幅度 <= 1 个 EPS 或一好一坏且无法判定

secondary: pixel AUROC / AUPRO（Family C 不可得，标记 NA）

elimination.family_A: bottle PASS→FAIL / 新 catastrophic / robustness 退化且仅 trade-off / preservation 明显退化而 robustness 仅小幅改善 → 淘汰；最多 Top3 补 screw/grid，Top2 进入 cross-family
elimination.family_B: 全部只是单边 trade-off → STOP FAMILY B；出现 Pareto → 补 screw/grid；>=4/5 PASS 且 0 catastrophic 才进 cross-family
elimination.family_C: 阈值投机翻转标记 threshold-sensitive 并降排名

tiers.S: ≥13/15 + 0 catastrophic + cable≥2/3 + hazelnut≥2/3 + bottle 3/3 + screw 3/3 → FINAL METHOD CANDIDATE
tiers.A: 12/15 但 catastrophic 1→0 或 worst Δd′ 明显改善或 cable/hazelnut consistency 改善 → SERIOUS FINAL CANDIDATE
tiers.B: 11-12/15 且无明显优于 B2 → 归档

stages.D: Top4 x 5 cats x seed0 (需 >=4/5 PASS 且 0 catastrophic)
stages.E: Top2 x 5 cats x seeds{1,2}（5x3 最终确认）
